description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Collective Agreements entered into between the Bata shce Company of Ceylon Limited and Wanija Ha Karmika Sevaka Sangamaya and between Brown & Company PLC, Browns Group Industries (Pvt.)  Limited and Browns thermal Engineering (Pvt.) Limited of the one part and the Samastha Lanka Welanda Ha Karmika Kamkaru Sangamaya of the other Part (E Only)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a collective agreement between a company and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions about employment terms, wages, working conditions, and dispute resolution mechanisms. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves the publication of a legally binding agreement and regulatory framework governing industrial relations, consistent with the definition of "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" in the classification guidelines.
